ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels vs. 25% low-intensity black/dark-brown pixels, with dark values concentrated at the peduncle and fluke margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields dominate both lobes. Dark pigmentation is mapped along the entire trailing edge and peduncle insertion. Distinct yellowish-tan mottling is localized around the median notch, and small isolated dark-pixel circles are scattered across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetric V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle and a depth roughly 1/10th of the vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits sharper, more defined pixel-amplitude peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the trailing boundary, terminating in sharp upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of dark circular rings and solid spots (scars) mapped primarily in the outer distal quadrants of both lobes; several larger rings present in the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three parallel dark linear streaks on the mid-left lobe and one prominent vertical scratch on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, highly textured dark pixel clusters on the distal-most tips of both lobes indicating heavy barnacle colonization; extensive yellowish-brown pigmentation radiating from the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast white focal point (active barnacle) is visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
